quarterly_data.quarter: Rambus press release: Rambus Advances Power-Efficient AI Infrastructure with (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rambus announced a Power Management IC (PMIC) designed for the upcoming LPDDR6 SOCAMM2 server memory modules (LPDDR6 SOCAMM2 is 'in development now'), which it calls industry-leading; it is currently sampling to lead customers. Developed in technical cooperation with customers and ecosystem partners, the PMIC, together with the Rambus SPD Hub, extends the company's LPDDR-based module roadmap beyond its complete LPDDR5X SOCAMM2 chipset for the current generation, providing module-level power conversion, sequencing, telemetry and fault protection. SVP and GM of Memory Interface Chips Rami Sethi: the PMIC 'builds on our leadership in server-memory power management.'
quarterly_data.figure: LPDDR6 SOCAMM2 PMIC sampling to lead customers
